en.metaDescription: Learn about the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority, the governing body of the Subic Bay Freeport Zone.
en.title: Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority
en.subtitle: The governing body of the Subic Bay Freeport Zone
en.intro: The Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA) is the government agency responsible for the development and management of the Subic Bay Freeport Zone (SBFZ). Established in 1992 after the departure of the US military from Subic Bay Naval Base, the SBMA has successfully transformed the area into one of the Philippines' most successful economic zones.
en.mandateDesc: SBMA's mandate includes the administration, operation, and development of the Subic Bay Freeport Zone as a self-sustaining industrial, commercial, financial, and investment center.
en.functionInvestDesc: Attracting and facilitating investments within the freeport zone.
en.functionInfraDesc: Developing and maintaining world-class infrastructure and facilities.
en.functionEnvDesc: Environmental protection and sustainable development programs.
en.closing: Locators within SBGP benefit from the favorable business climate and incentives offered by the SBMA, including tax holidays, duty-free imports, and streamlined business registration processes.
